name: com.alexgofman.retrofit-localization
description: Localization for a Unity project that was written in one language and is already live: string tables with reported fallbacks, in-place refresh of static string pools, a label sweep for untouched UI, plural rules, Korean particles and tag-aware Arabic shaping, plus Editor audits.

samples.description: Demo tables in five languages and a script that builds a small UI with a language picker.
Adapter that plugs the RTLTMPro library in as the Arabic shaper. Needs RTLTMPro and the RETROFIT_L10N_RTLTMPRO scripting define.
